description: This file contains inline functions and macros related to jemalloc internal operations, including CPU affinity, arena data management, and thread cache handling.

methods.name: malloc_getcpu
methods.description: Returns the current CPU number, using platform-specific calls.

methods.name: percpu_arena_choose
methods.description: Selects an arena index based on current CPU and configuration.

methods.name: percpu_arena_ind_limit
methods.description: Calculates the limit of per-CPU arena indices based on mode.

methods.name: arena_tdata_get
methods.description: Retrieves thread-specific arena data, with optional refresh.

methods.name: arena_get
methods.description: Gets the arena object for a given index, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: decay_ticker_get
methods.description: Retrieves the decay ticker for a specific thread data index.

methods.name: tcache_small_bin_get
methods.description: Accesses a small bin in the thread cache.

methods.name: tcache_large_bin_get
methods.description: Accesses a large bin in the thread cache.

methods.name: tcache_available
methods.description: Checks if thread cache is available for the current thread.

methods.name: tcache_get
methods.description: Retrieves the thread cache for the current thread if available.

methods.name: pre_reentrancy
methods.description: Prepares thread state for reentrant operations.

methods.name: post_reentrancy
methods.description: Restores thread state after reentrant operations.
